chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who had wealth deposited, and when it was near the head of the year, he spent it before the year passed over it. Is Zakat upon him? He said: No.

key_terms.رَأْسُ الْحَوْلِ: The beginning of the year of possession for Zakat calculation
key_terms.يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ: To pass over (referring to the lunar year)

ai.seo_question: Is Zakat due on wealth if it is spent before the full year of possession has passed?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that Zakat is not obligatory on wealth spent before the completion of the lunar year (hawl), as the condition of time is a prerequisite for the duty to arise. This ruling highlights the principle that Zakat is tied to the state of possession at the time of the annual cycle's completion, a key distinction in Shia fiqh regarding the timing of liability. The hadith underscores the mercy in Islamic law by relieving the owner of the burden if the wealth is utilized or distributed prior to the hawl.
